items.q: I think it was Lewis Taylor. He was a boy from Chicago... And that gave me a chance to join that band. At that time it was called the Quality Serenaders

ctx.x: And when you first went into the Cotton Club you said that you were replacing a trombone player who had left and that his name was Taylor. I didn't get his first name.

I think it was Lewis Taylor. He was a boy from Chicago, and I think he was sick and he had to leave the west coast and go back to Chicago. And that gave me a chance to join that band. At that time it was called the Quality Serenaders, Uh-huh.
